dishes.name: Tomato Meat Ball
dishes.instructions:
1. Season ground beef with salt, pepper, and shape into 12-14 round meatballs.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sear meatballs until browned on all sides (5-7 mins).
3. Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and diced tomatoes with sauce.
4. Simmer gently on low heat for 20 minutes until sauce thickens and meatballs are cooked through.
5. Garnish with fresh herbs and serve hot over rice or pasta.

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken Teriyaki
dishes.instructions:
1. Pat chicken thighs dry and prick skin with a fork for crispiness.
2. Mix soy sauce, mirin/honey, sugar, and minced ginger in a small bowl.
3. Pan-sear chicken skin-side down in a hot skillet for 6 minutes until golden and crispy, then flip.
4. Pour sauce mixture into the pan and simmer until glazed and bubbly.
5. Slice chicken and drizzle with rich pan glaze. Serve with steamed rice and broccoli.

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken Curry
dishes.instructions:
1. Cut chicken, potatoes, carrots, and onions into bite-sized chunks.
2. In a deep pot, sauté onions in oil until translucent, then add chicken and brown lightly.
3. Add carrots and potatoes, pour in water to cover, and bring to a simmer for 15 mins.
4. Turn off heat, dissolve Japanese curry roux cubes into the broth, stirring until velvety smooth.
5. Simmer on low heat for 5 more minutes until luscious. Serve over fluffy Japanese rice.

dishes.name: Cantonese Scallion Oil Noodles
dishes.instructions:
1. Slice scallions into 2-inch segments, separating white and green parts.
2. Heat oil in a pan on medium-low. Fry scallion whites first, then greens until crisp and browned (8 mins).
3. Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar to the scallion oil. Simmer 1 minute.
4. Boil wheat or ramen noodles until al dente, drain well.
5. Toss noodles in the warm fragrant scallion sauce and top with crispy scallion threads.
